description: This Java source file defines the NumberVariable class, which models numeric variables (such as int, double, etc.) in a code generation framework. It includes methods for type identification, code generation for encoding/decoding JSON and native representations, and handles different numeric types (e.g., float, int, long).

classes.name: NumberVariable
classes.description: Represents a numeric variable for code generation, supporting various numeric types and generating code for serialization/deserialization in JSON and native formats.

methods.name: NumberVariable(ICNumVariable bean)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the variable from an ICNumVariable bean, setting its type and nativeSigned attributes.

methods.name: NumberVariable(String varName, ICNumType.Enum kind)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the variable with a name and type, without native implementation specifics.

methods.name: resolveReferences
methods.description: Overrides method; no references to resolve in this class.

methods.name: isShort
methods.description: Checks if the variable type is short.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the variable type is int.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the variable type is long.

methods.name: isFloat
methods.description: Checks if the variable type is float.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if the variable type is double.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Returns the C language type corresponding to the variable's numeric type, considering whether it is signed or unsigned.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type corresponding to the variable's numeric type.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JSON key string associated with the variable's type.

methods.name: getXmlDefinedType
methods.description: Returns the ICNumType enum representing the variable's type.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to encode this variable into JSON using cJSON library.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to decode this variable from JSON using cJSON library.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code to encode this variable into a JSON structure.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code to decode this variable from a JSON structure.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Returns the IPC object type string for Java serialization based on the variable's type.
